'''Vortex 6''' was a [[Ardan resistance|Rebel]] who was affiliated with [[Vortex Squadron (Arda I)|Vortex Squadron]].

==History==
Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Vortex 6 scanned the sectors [[Sector 42|42]] and [[Sector 43|43]].<ref name="OAA1" />
